events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Agree access to plant data and people
events.decision: Will the plant give the team its cost data and access to line staff from week 1?
agenda: Present the Diagnostic objective and the weeks 1 to 5 steps
Discuss the plant data and line access the evidence work needs
Confirm who gives the team access to data and people at the plant

events.label: Check-in: baseline findings
events.purpose: Review line losses and the cost baseline
events.decision: Which cost drivers from the findings should the sizing cover in weeks 4 and 5?
agenda: Review line loss observations and cost driver findings
Review the conversion cost per part baseline for the Braga plant
Discuss which cost drivers the sizing should cover next

events.label: Initiatives go/no-go
events.decision: Which sized initiatives go into implementation at the plant, and which stop here?
agenda: Present the sized improvement list with baseline for go/no-go
Review the line loss findings and the cost per part baseline
Decide which initiatives go into implementation and which stop

events.label: Workshop: go-live readiness
events.decision: Which improvements are ready to go live at the plant, and which wait?
agenda: Review the improvement detail and change sequence for each improvement
Review the cost per part tracker and how results will be read
Decide which improvements are ready to go live and which wait

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Close out results and plant handover
events.decision: Approve the results against the baseline and the handover to the plant team?
agenda: Present the results and handover pack against the baseline
Review the go-live record, training materials and ownership register
Decide on approval of the results and the handover to the plant team
